newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to set rules for regional Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia to set rules for regional Eurobonds.

text.p: The Russian government may approve rules for regions issuing Eurobonds by the end of the week, a spokeswoman for First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin said on Monday.
"If everything goes well with the draft regulation it may be signed by the Prime Minister by the end of the week," she told Reuters.
The Finance Ministry is now brushing up the draft, she said.
She said the document would define the following criteria:
-- financial situation in the region, including the volume of debt and the budget structure;
-- existence of a credit rating for the region.
Several Russian regions and cities, including Moscow, Nizhny Novgorod and St Petersburg plan to issue Eurobonds, but the bonds have been delayed because the relevant Russian legislation is not clear.
